verdict.rationale: Gram is a SaaS control plane with a platform API, CLI and MCP server, so versioned APIs and a deprecation policy are a fair question to ask. The evidence pack documents neither API versioning nor a deprecation policy. Versioned SKILL.md manifests and deployment history with redeploys are different features and earn no credit, and no public OpenAPI spec was found.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
